remarks: Spectacular home completely rebuilt from the ground up into a stunning brand new Colonial, offering the perfect blend of modern design and quality craftsmanship. Featuring a bright open floor plan with wide plank hardwood floors throughout, this home is designed for today's lifestyle. The gorgeous custom kitchen boasts a large center island, ample cabinetry, and flows seamlessly into the main living areas. The first floor also offers a versatile office/guest room/bonus room to fit your needs. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite features a beautiful spa-like bath and walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms are serviced by another stylish modern full bath. The finished lower level adds approximately 740sf of additional living space and includes a stunning full bath with a large walk-in shower, perfect for extra room for the family or as a potential in-law set up. Situated on a beautiful lot in a highly desirable and convenient location close to shopping, restaurants, beach, schools, train, and major highways. Everything is new, nothing to do but move in.
